cases.question: Count cache errors from noon inclusive to 12:01 exclusive on September 24, 2026 UTC.
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE service_name='cache' AND severity='ERROR' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-24 12:00:00' AND timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-24 12:01:00'

cases.question: List all cache messages after noon inclusive, preserving duplicate occurrences.
cases.sql: SELECT body FROM logs WHERE service_name='cache' AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-24 12:00:00' ORDER BY timestamp
